difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes whose fibres are geometrically irreducible, the lemma produces a Noetherian approximation diagram in which the approximating morphism again has geometrically irreducible fibres. The proof invokes the general approximation lemma to obtain the diagram and then verifies that geometric irreducibility, being a finite-presentation condition on the fibres, descends to the approximation. Descending the geometric irreducibility condition to the approximation is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 9888-9912.
